turns.instruction:
Build the 6 m spatial cantilever column in OpenSees using the attached input. Its Iy/Iz table conflicts with the local-axis annotation: the two labels are interchanged. Confirm which table and axis orientation govern before giving numerical results. Keep the top global force (20,15,-400) kN and the separate mid-height global X force -8 kN at Z=3 m. Report top global Uz, Ux and Uy and base support Rz and My, with signed units, case D and current turn.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

Use the corrected attachment. Both column segments point upward: local x=+global Z, local y=-global Y, local z=+global X, with reference vector +global X and zero roll. Rectangle B=300 mm along local y, H=500 mm along local z; use the corrected complete A/Iy/Iz/J table. Preserve all support and global load vectors and the separate -8 kN load at Z=3 m. Now analyze. Report top global Uz, Ux and Uy and base support Rz and My, with signed units, case D and current turn.
